name: Blood Transfusions
overview: Scripture clearly instructs believers to abstain from blood, emphasizing its sacredness as the life of the flesh. From Genesis 9:4 and Leviticus 3:17, God commands His people not to consume blood, establishing this as a perpetual statute. The New Testament reinforces this principle in Acts 15:20 and 15:29, where the early church directed believers to avoid blood along with other practices, underscoring the ongoing spiritual significance of respecting God's command regarding blood.
